replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Going to start with the main layout. The map is nothing special at first sight but then looking at paths they seem really nicely designed. Good path layout, enough room on the front and a nice void gap are good.

While the map looks a bit plain with mostly stone brick (could add wood) the grass and clay really stand out on top. Something though I would like to see is a bit less clay at the back area (make it like in front where its small patches not full road).

The map could use some height changes on the top layer. Its pretty much flat if I dont could the small amount of changes that are in the cobblestone "walls" around paths. Makes the map look a bit boring. It could also use more decoration (flowers maybe and wood in the palette (mentioned above)).

The monuments are really nice and visible. The only issue I see with it is the size. They seem very big and I would make them a bit smaller. 

Since there are no monuments on the lower area and behind the stairs its mostly filled in (i guess, theres no pics) I think a nice addition would be adding a room behind there or just opening the area up where you could have some extra supplies and possibly iron blocks (I only see diamond atm).

While the map looks like it could play decently right now, I think there should be aesthetic improvements.

I know rockymine and he is amazing with these kinds of things. Seeing him as a contributer is nice but the map doesn't look as nearly as great as some other maps that he created for Overcast. The plain walls could need more decoration like wood on it, the top area could be decorated more (mentioned above, flowers) and it could be less flat on top.

Other than that I think this map has potential and I can't wait to see it develop further and possibly be in the tournament.
